resume.summary: Digital marketing, paid media, e-commerce, analytics, and marketing-technology leader with 14+ years of experience across agency, in-house, B2B, B2C, e-commerce, professional services, and high-volume performance marketing environments. Experience spans Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, multi-channel media, SEO/SEM, e-commerce operations, conversion tracking, attribution, forecasting, statistical modeling, automation, database/reporting systems, website development, and cross-functional leadership. Combines marketing strategy with strong technical capability in Python, SQL, JavaScript, VBA, APIs, data visualization, and modern AI-assisted workflows. Extremely proficient in using Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, and many other supplemental AI systems.
